evidence: Target-device capability probe reports caps=1, pVM=true, nonPVM=false, custom=true, gpuApi=true, displayApi=true. The previous major build regressed Gate A by dynamically loading libvm_payload from the payload namespace; Microdroid then powered off. This build restores the previously proven self-contained infinite payload and auto-restarts Gate A before guest commands. Debian now attempts the official custom image as a protected VM on pVM-only devices with standard pVM networking disabled.
note: AOSP allows the custom-image config and protectedVm flag to coexist at the API level, but pvmfw may still reject an image that does not satisfy protected-boot trust requirements. Runtime device logs are authoritative. Do not infer Debian, display, KDE, GLES, Vulkan or hardware acceleration PASS from code presence.
